recentItems.title: Playing For Their Dreams! 🏓🥇 | FULL Table Tennis Final | Paris 2024
recentItems.description:
📺 Re-live #Paris2024! ➡️ https://oly.ch/3REmN8s

Chen Meng of the People’s Republic of China defeated her teammate Sun Yingsha in the women’s table tennis singles final to capture Olympic gold at Paris 2024 by a final score of 4-2.
The 30-year-old became the third woman in history to win back-to-back Olympic golds in the event after topping the podium at Tokyo 2020.

recentItems.title: Madison Chock & Evan Bates "Paint it Black" 💃🏼🎶 | Music Monday
recentItems.description:
📺 Re-live all the #MilanoCortina2026 action: https://go.olympics.com/watch 

The USA's triple world champions and 2-time team Olympic gold medallists Madison Chock & Evan Bates took to the ice with a bull-fighting-inspired free dance to "Paint it Black" by Ramin Djawadi at Milano Cortina 2026. They finished on a strong silver medal just off of France's Laurence Fournier Beaudry and Guillaume Cizeron.

Relive the best moments from the Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Olympic Games, featuring elite athletes, thrilling competition, and unforgettable highlights across the world’s top winter sports on the Olympic stage.

recentItems.title: Backstroke Thriller Ends With Italian Gold 🇮🇹🏊‍♂️ | 100m Backstroke Final at Paris 2024
recentItems.description:
📺 Re-live #Paris2024! ➡️ https://oly.ch/3REmN8s

Italy’s Thomas Ceccon now has an Olympic gold medal to add to his world record and world championship in the men’s 100m backstroke. Ceccon was followed by Xu Jiayu from the People's Republic of China for the silver medal, with Team USA’s Ryan Murphy picking up the bronze at Paris 2024.
